description:
List the datasets people have asked publicdata.au to build, most votes first. Use it to see what is wanted or under way, or to check that a vote counted.
To add a vote use upvote_dataset. To read a dataset that is already served use search_datasets.
Votes on catalogue records that no entry has claimed yet come back apart, under the vote key search_catalogue uses.
The whole backlog comes back in one answer, with no paging, and the call costs nothing against the rate limit.
